posts.author: Sternenprinzessin
posts.body:
Hello everyone,
I’m currently looking for a large frog or preferably a toad enemy in frontview to use as a miniboss. The idea is for it to block the player’s path.
I’ve been searching for a while but couldn’t find anything that really matches the RPG Maker MV style.
A matching character sprite for map use would be great as well, but the battler is much more important since that’s the part I can’t create myself.
I own all RPG Maker versions, so I’m open to resources from any engine, as long as the art style fits MV.
Ideally, I’m looking for something that is free to use (commercial use would be a big plus).
Thanks in advance!
